<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.194, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 267.187 Da. The formula C₁₅H₂₅NO₃ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 267.183 Da (error < 4 mDa) and yields an integer double‑bond equivalent (DBE = 4), making it a chemically plausible candidate. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C15H25NO3.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H25NO3</final_answer>
